title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
subtitle: smooth, rich two-ingredient-style fudge made with sweetened condensed milk, no candy thermometer needed
imageAlt: Neat squares of glossy dark chocolate fudge stacked on a white plate on a navy napkin
servingsNote: 36 small squares from a 20 cm pan: rich, so 3 each is plenty

beforeYouStart.text: Low heat only. Chocolate scorches and turns grainy if it gets hot.
It sets in the fridge about 2 hours (included).

steps.title: Line the pan
steps.text: Line a 20 cm (8-inch) square pan with parchment, leaving the ends hanging over the sides.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Put the chocolate chips, condensed milk and salt in a heavy saucepan over low heat and stir constantly 4–6 minutes, just until melted and smooth.

steps.title: Vanilla
steps.text: Take off the heat and stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Spread evenly in the pan and refrigerate about 2 hours, until firm.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Lift out by the parchment and cut into 6 rows each way for 36 squares, wiping the knife between cuts.

fixIt.fix: The heat was too high. Take it off the heat and stir in 1–2 tbsp milk until glossy again.
Give it longer in the fridge; it firms up overnight. Check you used sweetened condensed milk, not evaporated.
It's too cold. Let it sit 10 minutes and use a hot, dry knife.

saleTip: Chocolate chips are on sale almost every week in December at No Frills; the store brand works perfectly here.
swap: Microwave: melt the chips, condensed milk and salt in a large microwave-safe bowl on medium, 1 minute, then in 20-second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth.
leftovers: Chop and stir into brownie batter or cookie dough.
doneness: Firm enough to cut cleanly with no soft centre.
source: Based on the classic condensed-milk fudge (Eagle Brand Canada): semi-sweet chocolate melted with sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and a pinch of salt, set in a 20 cm pan.
prepAhead: Make up to 2 weeks ahead and keep in the fridge, or freeze up to 3 months.
reheat: Not needed. Let it sit at room temperature 10 minutes before serving.

basic.note: Chocolate, condensed milk and salt only.

stepNotes.2: Basic: skip the vanilla; just spread it in the pan.

fancy.note: Topped with toasted pecans and a few flakes of salt.

stepNotes.0: Fancy: first toast the pecan halves in a dry skillet over medium 3–4 minutes, until fragrant, and cool them.
stepNotes.3: Fancy: before chilling, press a pecan half into each square-to-be (6 rows of 6) and sprinkle with the coarse salt.

plating: Mini paper cups make it look like a candy-shop box.
Stack in a tin with parchment between layers.

why.0-1: Sweetened condensed milk is already cooked down, so the fudge sets smooth without boiling sugar to a temperature.
why.0-2: A pinch of salt keeps it from tasting flat-sweet.

funFact: Eagle Brand condensed milk has been sold in Canada since the 1850s, and this fudge has been printed on the label for generations.

keeps.room: 1 week in an airtight container, or 2–3 weeks in the fridge
keeps.note: wrap well, with parchment between layers
keeps.thaw: In the fridge overnight, then 10 minutes on the counter
